import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Radical
theorem p2_n001 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v3 < p2v0)) (h1 : (p2v0 < p2v1)) (h2 : (p2v2 < p2v4)) (h3 : (p2v1 = p2v2)) : (p2v3 < p2v1) := by
  exact @LT.lt.trans Nat _ p2v3 p2v0 p2v1 h0 h1

theorem p2_n002 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v3 < p2v0)) (h1 : (p2v0 < p2v1)) (h2 : (p2v2 < p2v4)) (h3 : (p2v1 = p2v2)) : (p2v3 < p2v2) := by
  exact @Eq.trans_gt Nat _ p2v3 p2v1 p2v2 h3 (p2_n001 p2v0 p2v1 p2v2 p2v3 p2v4 h0 h1 h2 h3)

theorem p2_n003 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v3 < p2v0)) (h1 : (p2v0 < p2v1)) (h2 : (p2v2 < p2v4)) (h3 : (p2v1 = p2v2)) : (p2v3 < p2v4) := by
  exact @LT.lt.trans Nat _ p2v3 p2v2 p2v4 (p2_n002 p2v0 p2v1 p2v2 p2v3 p2v4 h0 h1 h2 h3) h2

theorem p2_target (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v3 < p2v0)) (h1 : (p2v0 < p2v1)) (h2 : (p2v2 < p2v4)) (h3 : (p2v1 = p2v2)) : (p2v3 < p2v4) := by
  exact (p2_n003 p2v0 p2v1 p2v2 p2v3 p2v4 h0 h1 h2 h3)
